data.name: Best of Boston Private Tour
data.headline: Walk the Freedom Trail, step inside the Paul Revere House, and photograph iconic Acorn Street — one relaxed day with a private guide and luxury van.
data.description: Our original Boston tour — the perfect introduction for first-time visitors! Begin your morning in the North End, Boston's "Little Italy," with a coffee and pastry at the neighborhood's oldest cafe. Then explore the Freedom Trail with your guide: step inside the Paul Revere House (entry included), admire the Old North Church, and visit the USS Constitution and Bunker Hill Monument. After a lunch break, hear the stories of Boston Common, photograph iconic Acorn Street on Beacon Hill, and stroll America's first botanical garden. A private luxury van and door-to-door pickup keep the whole day relaxed — see everything without feeling rushed.

highlight_box.title: The Perfect Introduction to Boston
highlight_box.description: Description: See all of Boston's must-see sites in one relaxed day: the Freedom Trail, Paul Revere House, Beacon Hill, and more — with a private guide, luxury van, and door-to-door hotel pickup.

data.highlights:
This is our original tour — the one Boston Hidden Gems was built on — and it remains the single best way to see Boston for the first time. In one 5.5-hour day, you cover the ground most visitors need two or three days to reach on foot.

The private van is the secret weapon: it carries you across the bridge to Charlestown's naval history and delivers you to Beacon Hill's cobblestone streets, so you experience the whole story of the city, not just the walkable downtown core.

You'll also go beyond the postcard views. Your guide shares stories that your history books skip: a riot sparked by the "King's Pines", purple window panes that became status symbols, and a beloved swan couple hiding a secret.

And you'll do it all as the only group on the tour. Start when you like, linger where you're fascinated, and adjust the route to check off your bucket-list sites — the day is genuinely yours.
data.itinerary:
1. 30 min - Pick Up
Your guide will pick you up in a comfortable minivan, as you begin your day in style!

2. 30 min - Caffe Vittoria
At the North End's oldest cafe, enjoy a beverage and a pastry while you learn about the North End through a series of maps and stories.

3. 30 min - Paul Revere House
Step inside downtown Boston's oldest building, the Paul Revere House, where his Midnight Ride began. Entry is included in your tour.

4. 15 min - North Square
See North Square, one of Boston's oldest public spaces. Explore the public artwork honoring the neighborhood's hisory!

5. 10 min - Old North Church
Admire Boston's oldest standing church from outside, where the famous signal lanterns were hung to warn of the British approach. Standing beneath the iconic steeple, hear how a young Paul Revere rang the church bells as a teenager and later organized the lantern signal that launched the midnight ride!

6. 15 min - Copp's Hill
Explore Copp's Hill burying ground, where many of our earliest settlers and some Revolutionaries are buried.

7. 20 min - USS Constitution
Stop by the world's oldest commissioned ship of war and learn about her construction, authorized by President George Washington.

8. 20 min - Bunker Hill Monument
See the obelisk and learn about one of the first major battles of the American Revolution

9. 60 min - Break
Take a break for lunch at a local artisanal market, with plenty of choices!

10. 30 min - Boston Common
Hear stories about the Pine Tree Riots, the founding of Boston, and the country's first football club!

11. 20 min - Acorn St/Beacon Hill
In one of America's most beautiful neighborhoods, stroll along the brick-laid streets and stop by the most photographed street in the country!

12. 20 min - Public Garden
In America's first botanical garden, learn about the (contested) discovery of anaesthesia, and Boston's infamous 4-time non-consecutive mayor.

13. 30 min - Drop Off
Your guide will drop you off back at your hotel, cruise ship, or airport!

data.special_requirements:
Massachusetts law requires proper car seats until children are 8 years old or 57 inches tall. We do not provide car seats, and refunds will not be available day of for lack of proper seating.

Vehicle size does not account for luggage; let us know if you'll need to bring luggage along so we can ensure we have space.
data.restrictions: The tour includes approximately 2.5 hours of walking spread across the day, and the private vehicle allows rest between walking portions. We are happy to adjust the pace or itinerary for any mobility level.
data.disclaimers: We run rain or shine unless there is a declared weather emergency.
data.faqs:
How much walking is involved?
The tour includes approximately 2.5 hours of walking spread throughout the 5.5-hour experience. We move at a comfortable pace with plenty of stops, and our private vehicle allows us to rest between walking portions. We're happy to adjust the pace or itinerary for any mobility needs.
Is this tour suitable for children?
Yes! Children of all ages are welcome. Our guides are skilled at making history fun and engaging for younger guests with interactive stories and humor. The combination of walking and driving helps keep kids interested throughout the tour. Massachusetts law requires proper car seats until children are 8 years old or 57 inches tall. We do not provide car seats.
What if it rains?
Tours run rain or shine! Since this tour includes a private vehicle, you'll stay comfortable and dry between stops. We recommend bringing an umbrella and wearing weather-appropriate clothing for the walking portions.
Can you pick us up from the airport or cruise port?
We offer door-to-door pickup and drop-off from your hotel or the Boston Flynn Cruiseport (surcharge applies for cruiseport). Pickup is not available at Boston Logan International Airport.
What's the difference between this tour and the Boston & Cambridge tour?
The Best of Boston tour focuses entirely on Boston's historic downtown, Freedom Trail, and Beacon Hill. It's 5.5 hours and perfect if you want an in-depth Boston experience. The Boston & Cambridge tour adds Harvard and MIT across the river for a broader overview of both cities.
